summary: KBS Real Estate Investment Trust III filed an 8-K on September 27, 2026 to disclose the second renewal of its advisory agreement with KBS Capital Advisors LLC, extending the current advisory agreement through September 27, 2027 on unchanged terms, with unlimited successive one-year renewals by mutual consent. Either party may terminate on 60 days' written notice without cause, or the company may terminate immediately for cause or advisor bankruptcy. No deal economics, premium, or target are implicated, making this a routine contract extension rather than a special situation; no risk-arb angle applies.
